capabilities: Show the first or last few lines of a note
Show one section or block of a note
Expand the hidden lines in place or open the note
Render peeks inside callouts and admonitions
Update the peek when the source note changes
extras: No settings and no data stored; installed manually from release assets (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css).
intentEvidence: A normal embed (![[note]]) always shows the whole note.
problem: A normal embed (![[note]]) always shows the whole note, so long lists or logs do not fit neatly into a dashboard, callout or admonition.

relations.evidence: It works anywhere a code block works — including inside callouts and Admonition blocks

summary: Markdown code block that shows only the first or last few lines, or one section, of another note, with a link to expand or open the rest.
